svg.title: Buck: Cin, Cout, load decoupling and quiet feedback
svg.desc: Illustrative PCB placement, not to scale or a vendor pinout. Amber is supply, blue is ground, violet is the switch node, green is quiet sensing. Rings are vias. Rectangular component ends are solder pads.
